results.canonical_news_title: AGEST ZERO TEST launched for AI-assisted post-patch testing

global_competitors.name: AGEST ZERO TEST
global_competitors.reason: Trigger itself is a commercial product using URL-led autonomous regression testing without maintained test cases.

global_competitors.name: Checkly
global_competitors.reason: Browser workflow checks, screenshots and regression monitoring; overlaps the same small web-team release verification job.

adjacent_competitors.name: Chromatic
adjacent_competitors.reason: Visual regression focused mainly on UI/component changes rather than full patch evidence.

competition_search_terms: no test case browser regression patch testing AI
URL autonomous regression testing web application
browser replay screenshot DOM diff release evidence
results.market_gap: The source development itself demonstrates direct commercialization; crowded testing market.
results.mvp: Record critical browser flow, replay, DOM/screenshot/network diff, human review and release report.
results.working_logic: Capture baseline -> apply patch -> replay flow -> diff -> reviewer accepts/rejects -> export evidence.
results.main_risk: Browser automation/runtime hosting may exceed true zero-cash deployment and is technically heavier than Lovable-first.
results.rejection_reason: AGEST ZERO TEST directly solves specification-light post-patch regression; other mature browser testing products also overlap.
